mainTopic: A נזיר who is in double doubt (maybe a מצורע, maybe impure from a corpse): how long he must wait, and how many shavings he needs, when his נזירות is a full year instead of the standard thirty days.
overview: The משנה described a נזיר with two doubts: he may be a מצורע, and he may have become impure from a dead body. The גמרא opens with a ברייתא saying the משנה's sixty and 120 days apply only to a thirty-day נזירות. With a year-long נזירות, he eats קדשים after two years and drinks wine after four. A second ברייתא lists his four shavings. At the first he brings the מצורע's birds, a bird חטאת and an animal עולה. At the second and third he brings a bird חטאת and an animal עולה, and at the fourth the offering of a pure נזיר. The גמרא then shows that the first shaving's offerings work whether he is a מצורע, טמא מת, or neither. It answers the missing אשם by following רבי שמעון, who lets him bring it with a condition. It explains that no new birds are needed later, and that the second and third bird חטאת offerings cover the doubts about his counting and his טומאה. The amud ends as he brings the fourth shaving's offering with a condition, whose wording continues on the next amud.

steps.title: The משנה's numbers apply only to a short נזירות
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא limits the משנה's sixty-day and 120-day figures to a standard thirty-day נזירות.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: It was taught: When is the משנה's rule said? When the person took on a short נזירות.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא that narrows the משנה's ruling to a short, thirty-day נזירות. This sets up the next step, which explains what happens when the נזירות is longer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה's numbers, sixty days and 120 days, are built from blocks of thirty days, one block for each possible shaving. The ברייתא points out that those numbers only work when each block is the standard thirty days. That opens the question of what happens with a longer term.

keyTerms.meaning: The discussion of the משנה
In what case are these words said? (a formula that limits a rule's scope)
A short נזירות, the standard thirty days

phrases.english: GEMARA:
It was taught: In what case are these words said?
phrases.notes: "These words" means the משנה's rule: eat קדשים after sixty days, drink wine after 120.

phrases.english: With a short naziriteship,
phrases.notes: This is the standard thirty-day term.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא on the משנה by limiting the משנה's case.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The משנה's sixty and 120 days apply only to a thirty-day נזירות.

steps.title: With a year-long נזירות, the waits become two years and four years
steps.stepSummary: For a one-year נזירות, he eats קדשים after two years and drinks wine and becomes impure from the dead after four years.
steps.simpleTranslation: But if he took on a one-year נזירות, he may eat קדשים only after two years. He may drink wine and become impure from the dead only after four years.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא gives the rule for a year-long נזירות. Each thirty-day block from the משנה turns into a full year.
steps.deeperAnalysis: He must keep a full year of נזירות before each shaving, because any one shaving might turn out to be for his נזירות. After two shavings, two years, the מצורע purification is finished no matter what, so he may eat קדשים. To be sure he has also completed a pure נזירות, he needs four shavings, four years, and only then may he drink wine.

keyTerms.meaning: A נזירות taken on for one year
Holy sacrificial food
Becomes impure from a dead body (forbidden to a נזיר)

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think he waits two years and then four more. Both numbers count from the start: by year two he may eat קדשים, and by year four, two years later, he may drink wine.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that the משנה's numbers are not fixed amounts of days. They are a count of waiting periods, and each period equals the length of the נזירות.

phrases.english: But with a naziriteship of a year,
he eats sacrificial food after two years,
and he drinks wine and becomes impure from the dead
after four years.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the ברייתא by giving the rule for the longer case that step 1 left open.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: With a one-year נזירות, he eats קדשים after two years, and drinks wine and becomes impure from the dead after four years.

steps.title: He shaves four times; the first shaving's offerings
steps.stepSummary: A second ברייתא says he shaves four separate times. At the first shaving he brings the מצורע's birds, a bird חטאת, and an animal עולה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And a ברייתא taught about this: He shaves four separate times. At the first shaving he brings birds, a bird חטאת, and an animal עולה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings another ברייתא that lists his four shavings. It begins with the offerings for the first shaving.
steps.deeperAnalysis: At the first shaving he might be a מצורע, so he brings the מצורע's two birds. He might also be a נזיר who became impure from a corpse, so he brings a bird חטאת. Or he might be a pure נזיר, so he brings an animal עולה. Each offering covers one possibility.

keyTerms.meaning: And it was taught about it (introduces a ברייתא on the same topic)
Shavings (plural of תִּגְלַחַת)
The two birds of a מצורע's purification
A bird sin-offering
An animal burnt-offering

phrases.english: And it was taught about it: And he shaves four shavings.
The first shaving: he brings birds,
phrases.notes: These are the two birds a מצורע brings when he becomes pure (ויקרא 14:4–7).

phrases.english: and a bird sin-offering, and an animal burnt-offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a second ברייתא that spells out the shavings behind the waiting periods in step 2.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: He shaves four times. The first shaving comes with the מצורע's birds, a bird חטאת, and an animal עולה.

steps.title: The offerings for the second, third, and fourth shavings
steps.stepSummary: At the second and third shavings he brings a bird חטאת and an animal עולה. At the fourth he brings the קרבן of a pure נזיר.
steps.simpleTranslation: At the second shaving he brings a bird חטאת and an animal עולה. At the third he brings a bird חטאת and an animal עולה. At the fourth he brings the offering of purity.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא finishes the list of what he brings at each of the remaining three shavings.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The מצורע's birds are brought only once, so they are not repeated after the first shaving. At the second and third shavings he again brings a bird חטאת and an animal עולה. Steps 11–13 explain that, in case he really was a confirmed מצורע, the second shaving's חטאת covers the doubt about his counting and the third's covers the doubt about his טומאה. At the fourth shaving he brings the full offering of a pure נזיר.

keyTerms.meaning: The offering of purity, meaning the full קרבנות of a נזיר who finished his term in purity

steps.whatToRemember: A doubtful מצורע who may also be impure from a corpse needs four shavings. With a year-long נזירות, each shaving comes a year apart: קדשים after two years, wine after four. Each shaving's offerings are chosen to cover every possibility.

phrases.aramaic: שְׁנִיָּה — מֵבִיא חַטַּאת הָעוֹף וְעוֹלַת בְּהֵמָה,
phrases.english: The second: he brings a bird sin-offering and an animal burnt-offering,

phrases.aramaic: שְׁלִישִׁית — מֵבִיא חַטַּאת הָעוֹף וְעוֹלַת בְּהֵמָה,
phrases.english: the third: he brings a bird sin-offering and an animal burnt-offering,
the fourth: he brings an offering of purity.

steps.triggerLanguage: שְׁנִיָּה — מֵבִיא חַטַּאת הָעוֹף וְעוֹלַת בְּהֵמָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the same ברייתא from step 3 and finishes the list of shavings.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Second and third shavings: a bird חטאת and an animal עולה. Fourth shaving: the offering of a pure נזיר.

steps.title: First shaving, first case: he is surely a מצורע but not טמא
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא shows the first-shaving offerings fit every possibility. It starts with the case where he is surely a מצורע and not טמא מת.
steps.simpleTranslation: You said that at the first shaving he brings the birds, a bird חטאת and an animal עולה. Whichever way you look at it, he is doing the right thing. If he is surely a מצורע and not טמא, the birds are what he owes. The bird חטאת was only brought because of a doubt, so it is buried. The עולה counts as a gift offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the ברייתא's first shaving and begins to show why its mix of offerings works in every case. This is the first of three possible cases.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The idea is to bring offerings that cover every possible status, so that nothing he truly owes is missing. If he is a sure מצורע, the birds count. The doubtful bird חטאת gets buried, and the עולה becomes a voluntary gift.

keyTerms.meaning: Whichever way you look at it; it works in every case
A shaving (of the head)
The two birds a מצורע brings for his purification
Goes to burial; it may not be eaten
A voluntary gift offering

steps.confusionAlert: Each offering is brought 'just in case.' In any one case some of them are what he truly owes, and the others become a gift or get buried.

phrases.english: You said: at the first shaving he brings, etc.
phrases.notes: This quotes the ברייתא from step 3: the מצורע's birds, a bird חטאת, and an animal עולה.

phrases.english: Whichever way you look at it, he brings properly,
for if he is definitely a מצורע
and he is not impure,
the birds are his obligation,
and the bird חטאת, brought out of doubt, goes to burial,
and the עולה becomes a gift offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Goes back to the first-shaving list in step 3 and starts explaining why it works.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: If he is a sure מצורע and not טמא, the birds are what he owes, the doubtful bird חטאת is buried, and the עולה is a gift.

steps.title: Why he cannot shave on the usual מצורע schedule
steps.stepSummary: He cannot do the מצורע shaving after seven days, because he might not be a confirmed מצורע. If so, he is still a נזיר who may not shave until his term is complete.
steps.simpleTranslation: But shaving him within seven days is not possible. Maybe he is not a confirmed מצורע, and the תורה said: 'No razor shall pass over his head until the days are completed.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the timing: why the first shaving waits for the end of the נזירות period instead of happening on the usual מצורע schedule.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If he really is not a מצורע, he is a נזיר in the middle of his term, and the תורה forbids him to shave. Since we cannot rule that out, he must wait until his נזירות days are done. This is why the first shaving comes after thirty days.

keyTerms.meaning: A confirmed מצורע, officially declared impure
A razor
The Merciful One; the Torah

phrases.english: But shaving him within seven days is impossible,
phrases.notes: He means shaving at the normal time for a מצורע, before his נזירות days are over.

phrases.english: for perhaps he is not a confirmed מצורע,
and the Merciful One said:

phrases.aramaic: ״תַּעַר לֹא יַעֲבֹר עַל רֹאשׁוֹ עַד מְלֹאת״.
phrases.english: "No razor shall pass over his head until the days are completed."

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a timing point to the first case: even a possible מצורע must wait out the נזירות term.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The first shaving cannot happen on the מצורע's seven-day schedule, because a possible נזיר may not shave before his term ends.

steps.title: Second case: not a מצורע, but טמא מת
steps.stepSummary: If he is not a מצורע but is טמא מת, the bird חטאת is what he owes. The birds are done outside the Temple, so they cause no problem, and the animal עולה is a gift.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he is not surely a מצורע but he is טמא, the bird חטאת is what he owes. The מצורע's birds are done outside, so there is no problem of חולין in the עזרה. The animal עולה becomes a gift offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to the second possible case and shows the offerings still work.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here the bird חטאת is what a טמא נזיר owes. One might worry that the extra מצורע birds are ordinary, unholy animals being slaughtered in the Temple courtyard. They are not, because that ritual is done outside, so nothing wrong happens.

keyTerms.meaning: Outside (the Temple courtyard)
Ordinary (non-sacred) animals brought into the Temple courtyard, which is forbidden
A bird sin-offering

phrases.english: And if he is not definitely a מצורע,
and he is impure,
phrases.notes: Impure from a dead body, which is the doubt a נזיר has here.

phrases.english: the bird חטאת is his obligation,
and the birds are done outside,
so it is not a case of חולין in the עזרה.
And the animal עולה becomes a gift offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי לָאו מְצוֹרָע וַדַּאי הָוֵי, וְהוּא טָמֵא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Second of the three possible cases.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: If he is טמא but not a מצורע, the bird חטאת is what he owes, the birds cause no problem because they are done outside, and the animal עולה is a gift.

steps.title: Third case: neither a מצורע nor טמא
steps.stepSummary: If he is neither, the birds are harmless because they are done outside, the bird חטאת is buried, and the animal עולה is what he owes.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he is not a מצורע and not טמא, the birds are done outside, the bird חטאת is buried, and the animal עולה is what he owes.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes the three cases and shows the offerings work even if he has neither problem.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A pure נזיר finishing his term needs an animal עולה, so that offering now counts as what he owes. The other offerings are either harmless (the birds) or buried (the doubtful חטאת).

keyTerms.meaning: His obligation; what he truly owes
An animal burnt-offering
Impure (here, from a dead body)

steps.whatToRemember: In all three cases, the first-shaving offerings cover exactly what he might owe, and nothing forbidden happens.

phrases.aramaic: וְאִי לָאו מְצוֹרָע הוּא וְלָאו טָמֵא הוּא —
phrases.english: And if he is neither a מצורע nor impure,
the birds are done outside,
the bird חטאת goes to burial,
and the animal עולה is his obligation.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי לָאו מְצוֹרָע הוּא וְלָאו טָמֵא הוּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Third and last case, which completes the 'whichever way you look at it' proof.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: If he is neither a מצורע nor טמא, the animal עולה is what he owes, the birds are harmless, and the bird חטאת is buried.

steps.title: But a מצורע also needs an אשם
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges: a מצורע must also bring an אשם, so the list of offerings seems incomplete.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the ברייתא's list: a מצורע also has to bring an אשם, and it is missing.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A מצורע's purification is not complete without an אשם. One might think he cannot bring one here, since an אשם may not be brought just in case. So how can the ברייתא leave it out?

keyTerms.meaning: A guilt-offering; a מצורע must bring one to complete his purification
But surely; introduces a challenge
He needs; he is required

phrases.english: But he needs an אשם!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the completeness of the offering list just explained.
steps.kashyaTarget: The ברייתא's list of first-shaving offerings
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A מצורע needs an אשם, and the list leaves it out, so it looks like the list is missing something.

steps.title: The ברייתא follows רבי שמעון: bring it with a condition
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא follows רבי שמעון, who allows bringing the אשם on a condition. So the אשם is handled.
steps.simpleTranslation: This follows רבי שמעון, who said: he brings it and sets a condition.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge by saying whose opinion the ברייתא follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון holds that someone who is unsure whether he owes an אשם may still bring one, with a condition: if he owes it, it is his אשם; if not, it is a voluntary שלמים. So the אשם is not a problem.

keyTerms.meaning: He brings (the offering)
He sets a condition

steps.whatToRemember: The first-shaving offerings cover every possible case, and the missing אשם is solved by following רבי שמעון's 'bring it with a condition.'

phrases.english: This follows רבי שמעון,
who said: he brings it and sets a condition.
phrases.notes: The condition is: if I owe this, it's my אשם; if not, it's a voluntary שלמים.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן הִיא, דְּאָמַר: מַיְיתֵי וּמַתְנֵי
steps.terutzResolutionType: Says which opinion the ברייתא follows
steps.terutzHavaAmina: We thought a doubtful מצורע could not bring an אשם, so the list seemed incomplete.
steps.terutzMaskana: Following רבי שמעון, he brings the אשם with a condition, so his needs are covered.

steps.title: No new birds at the second and third shavings
steps.stepSummary: At the second and third shavings he does not need the מצורע birds again, because he already did that ritual.
steps.simpleTranslation: For the second and third shavings, he does not need birds, because he already did them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to the next shavings in the ברייתא. It says the special מצורע birds are not brought again, since that ritual was already done.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The מצורע bird ritual is a one-time step of purification. Once it has been done, repeating it adds nothing. So at shavings two and three, the only question left is which other offerings he still brings.

keyTerms.meaning: A shaving (of a נזיר or of a מצורע)
Birds; here, the two birds of the מצורע purification ritual
Because he already did it

phrases.english: The second and third shaving:
he does not need birds,
phrases.notes: These are the מצורע's two birds that are done outside the Temple, the ones mentioned back in step 7.

phrases.english: since he already did them.

steps.triggerLanguage: תִּגְלַחַת שְׁנִיָּה וּשְׁלִישִׁית צִיפּוֹרִין לָא צְרִיךְ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After settling the אשם, the גמרא continues the step-by-step explanation of the ברייתא with the next shavings.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The מצורע birds are not repeated at the second and third shavings, because that ritual was already done.

steps.title: What doubt is still left?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what concern remains that still calls for offerings at these shavings.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a short question to set up its next explanation: if the birds are finished, why bring anything at these shavings?
steps.deeperAnalysis: This is a clarifying question, not an attack. It asks what doubt the offerings at the second and third shavings are meant to cover.

keyTerms.meaning: What is there? What concern remains?

phrases.english: What is there to worry about?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Builds on step 11 by asking what the remaining offerings are for.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which doubt still requires offerings at the second and third shavings.

steps.title: Perhaps he was a confirmed מצורע
steps.stepSummary: Perhaps he really was a confirmed מצורע. So one bird חטאת covers the doubt about his counting, and one covers the doubt about his טומאה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Perhaps he really was a confirmed מצורע. So one offering is for the doubt about his counting, and one is for the doubt about his טומאה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers: we must worry that he truly was a confirmed מצורע. So the bird חטאת at the second shaving covers one doubt, and the one at the third shaving covers another.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If he was a real מצורע, his earlier offerings counted for his צרעת, not for his נזירות. That leaves two open doubts. One bird חטאת is for the doubt about his counting, and one is for the doubt about his טומאת מת.

keyTerms.meaning: A confirmed מצורע whom the כהן has declared definitely impure
His counting (of the days of his purification)
His טומאה, here his possible טומאת מת

phrases.english: Perhaps he is definitely a confirmed מצורע;
so one is for the doubt about his counting,
phrases.notes: "One" means one of the bird חטאת offerings. This one comes at the second shaving.

phrases.english: and one is for the doubt about his טומאה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Directly answers the question of step 12.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: We worry he was a confirmed מצורע, so one bird חטאת covers the doubt about his counting and one covers the doubt about his טומאה.
steps.whatToRemember: Shavings two and three have no new birds. Each brings a bird חטאת to cover a separate doubt in case he truly was a confirmed מצורע.

steps.title: The fourth shaving: an offering of purity with a condition
steps.stepSummary: At the fourth shaving he brings a קרבן טהרה and states a condition. The wording of the condition comes next.
steps.simpleTranslation: For the fourth shaving, he brings an offering of purity and states a condition.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא reaches the last shaving and says he brings a קרבן טהרה while stating a condition. This line sets up the actual words of the condition, which come right after.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because his status is still unsure, he cannot simply declare what the offering is for. So he attaches a condition, the same kind of tool רבי שמעון allowed for the אשם in step 10. That way the offering counts for whatever his true status turns out to be.

keyTerms.meaning: The offerings of a pure נזיר at the end of his term
He stipulates; he states a condition

phrases.english: The fourth shaving:
he brings an offering of purity
and states a condition,

steps.triggerLanguage: תִּגְלַחַת רְבִיעִית מֵבִיא קׇרְבַּן טׇהֳרָה וּמַתְנֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the order of shavings, now reaching the fourth and final one.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: At the fourth shaving he brings a קרבן טהרה and attaches a condition, whose wording follows.
